description: This Java class 'ChartRepository' manages a singleton repository of chart names, providing methods to add, retrieve, clear charts, and create controls with associated listeners.

classes.name: ChartRepository
classes.description: Singleton class that maintains a list of chart names and provides methods to manipulate them.

classes.name: ChartRepository.ChartRepositoryListener
classes.description: Interface defining a listener for digital chart events.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ChartRepository.

methods.name: getChart
methods.description: Retrieves a chart name by index, throws an exception if index is invalid.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of charts stored in the repository.

methods.name: addChart
methods.description: Adds a new chart name to the repository.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all charts from the repository.

methods.name: createControls
methods.description: Creates a ChartScrollControl object with a specified listener.
